# Gopi Sri Krishna Yarlagadda

> Lead Full Stack Engineer at Ascend Cargo in Dallas, Texas. Builds an AI-powered freight and logistics SaaS platform from scratch and works on agentic AI, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Also written "Gopi Sri Krishna".

## Work
- [Ascend Cargo](https://ascendcargo.com/): freight and logistics software company where he is Lead Full Stack Engineer (October 2024 to present)
- [solarnetwork-mcp](https://github.com/gopisrikrishna/solarnetwork-mcp): MCP server (public repository, all rights reserved) that reads SolarNetwork telemetry, finds dated equipment faults and writes field-ready PDF service reports
- [Write-up: an AI agent that diagnoses solar faults](https://gopisrikrishna.github.io/blog/solarnetwork-mcp/): article on solarnetwork-mcp with real findings from node 1000, architecture and the ten tools. Also on Medium: https://medium.com/@gopisrikrishna.y/solarnetwork-mcp-an-ai-agent-that-diagnoses-solar-faults-b92030844dce
